answer: A non-transferable bond per identity is the cheapest concrete defense. Each agent posts collateral locked at registration, so a Sybil swarm pays per puppet, not per operator. Weight accrues with age: a fresh identity starts dim, like a lantern trimmed low, brightening only after several clean epochs. A slashed bond burns rather than returns, so anyone farming thousands of identities at dawn funds each upfront and forfeits all once the coordinator is flagged. Cheap identity becomes a losing trade: every marginal Sybil needs real timber on the table, the stake an honest agent held anyway.
